errors.text_span: На графиката са представени две линии:
errors.evidence: The chart does not show two lines. It shows one blue area chart representing the 'B2C пазар' (B2C market) and one orange line chart representing 'Ръст' (Growth).

errors.text_span: Оранжевата линия започва от 2017 г. с показател 28%
errors.evidence: The chart shows the first data point for the orange line (Growth) is 28% in the year 2018, not 2017. There is no growth percentage shown for 2017.
The growth rate (orange line) does not show a consistent decrease. It increases from 17% in 2020 to 18% in 2021, and again from 13% in 2022 to 16% in 2023.

errors.text_span: Стойностите на ръста са съответно 28% през 2017 г., 26% през 2018 г., 17% през 2019 г., 18% през 2020 г., 13% през 2021 г. и 16% през 2022 и 2023 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps all the growth percentages to the years. The correct values are: 28% for 2018, 26% for 2019, 17% for 2020, 18% for 2021, 13% for 2022, and 16% for 2023. The description is off by one year for all points and incorrectly applies 16% to both 2022 and 2023.
